faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WCD Amravati East recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the WCD Amravati East recruitment is 17th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum educational qualification required for Anganwadi Sevika/Madatnis posts?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for both Anganwadi Sevika and Anganwadi Madatnis posts is passing the 12th grade or equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for applying to these posts is between 18 years and 35 years. There is also an age relaxation for widows up to 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: A total of 13 vacancies are available for Anganwadi Sevika and Anganwadi Madatnis posts in this recruitment drive by WCD Amravati East.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the WCD Amravati East recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this WCD Amravati East recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Anganwadi Sevika/Madatnis posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a merit list based on educational marks (80) and additional marks (20), followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for the Anganwadi Sevika / Madatnis posts is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Which districts are covered under WCD Amravati East?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for posts within Amravati East, Maharashtra. Specific areas within Amravati East will be detailed in the official notification.
